title: top15_us_pop_build_1

methods.identity: Each literal own-item live wbgetentities response (max 50 IDs, >=2 seconds between request starts, maxlag=5, exponential and Retry-After backoff), complete retained QLever bulk code inventory for discovery. Nondeprecated P774 full GEOID, or P590 exact Gazetteer ANSI. No inherited codes, name-only or containment-only joins.
methods.names: Same state, case/accent/punctuation normalized stored name equals full Census name or that name with one legal suffix removed. No fuzzy matches or alias substitution.
methods.kind: Stored local legal kind CDP requires a CDP place; incorporated city/town/village/borough requires incorporated place; township/charter township or legal town requires active MCD. Unincorporated communities, sections and other nonqualifying kinds held.
methods.polygon: Official 2020 cartographic boundary polygon, supplemented with full resolution 2020 TIGER/Line for failed containment; own GEOID and ANSI rechecked; original stored longitude/latitude strictly contained in a valid polygon. No tolerance or use of containing-unit population.
methods.population: 2020 Redistricting Data P.L. 94-171 P1_001N, retrieved as equivalent P0010001 in official legacy segment 1 column 6; exact LOGRECNO join with 2020 Census geography file. Full compressed segment retained, CRC32 and SHA256 verified; every selected P1 count independently equals POP100.
methods.api_fallback: Keyless Census API returned HTTP 200 redirect to /data/missing_key.html; diagnostic HTML retained. Official static Census ZIP segment 1 used instead. No API key obtained or required for ZIPs.
methods.scope: All 1805 cohort rows accounted once. Change only population and population_year. No identity events. Population/year field changes are inferred by migrations.py. Existing Census source credit retained without duplicate.

licence: US Census Bureau government works, public domain, 17 USC 105; Wikidata structured claims CC0 1.0
limitations: Polygon exclusion or invalidity is a named hold, never an assumption that the row denotes its containing unit. Generalized-boundary exclusions were rechecked using full resolution 2020 TIGER/Line.
